task_name: Phase A /routing: implement the seams until the T5 red tests pass
description: Startup catalog refresh falls back to a live redetect when detected is empty; a zero-provider catalog is never served or saved as fresh; the session provider/model is connected and pickable (current session); /routing shows visible states (no providers, unavailable with reason, auth failed, 0 models, why a category falls back) and reload() never sticks or rejects; the session pair reaches subagent routing resolution and keryx routing list.
test_result: 207 passed, 0 failed across 8 files (the 4 T5 files: 79 passed, 0 failed)

noticed_not_touched.what: routing-classifier-source.ts resolves categories with connectedPredicateFrom(providers) and no session argument. Passing the session makes an empty or stale provider list resolve to a no-op route to the session's own model, which breaks 5 existing tests (flow 411 provider-default rejections and the 'live picker catalog overrides stale startup ids' test). Left unchanged.

applyReviewRoutingCategory resolves the review category with connectedPredicateFrom(catalog) and has no session in scope, so an assignment to the review session's own model can still fall back at runtime.
keryx routing list still prints the generic 'not connected, falling back' wording because it does not pass the provider list to describeRejectionNotice; only /routing shows the new reasons.

assumptions: The default provider-loader timeout in /routing is 12s, above the catalog's own 8s per-provider bound.
catalogToFlatPickerProviders keeps excluding auth-failed providers by default (an existing test pins it); only /routing's loader opts in with withAuthFailed.

behavior_changes.description: Model tab status rows (shown above the picker, only when something is wrong): 'no providers connected — add one with /connect'; 'model list unavailable (<reason>)'; '<provider>: auth failed — /connect to re-enter the key'; '<provider>: 0 models'. Category fallback notices now read '<assignment> - provider list unavailable|provider not connected|model not in <provider>'s list, falling back to <resolved>' in /routing.
alternatives: Single-line status in the footer instead of rows above the picker
Keep the generic 'not connected' wording and only add the reason in a tooltip/detail line

behavior_changes.description: Auth-failed providers are listed on the Model tab and are neither selectable nor treated as connected; previously they were omitted entirely.
alternatives: Keep omitting them and only mention them in the startup notice

behavior_changes.description: /routing and the per-turn classifier loader now fall back to the live redetect when the catalog cache is empty or stale (the same detection /model uses); previously only the cache refresh ran its own detection.
alternatives: Only /routing falls back; leave the classifier loader on the cache-only path

notes: bun test exits 1 in this environment even with 0 failures (reproduced on src/commands/routing.test.ts, which I did not touch); the pass/fail counts are the signal. Docs: updated docs/docs/cli-reference.md (Live provider catalog section); cli-reference-coverage.test.ts passes.
